name: SCAIL-2 (Wan 2.1) — character replacement in video
description:
Swap the person in a video for your own character. Upload a picture of the character you want to see and a video of someone moving — SCAIL-2 replaces that person with your character, copying their motion while the rest of the scene stays. The built-in segmenter (SAM 3) finds who to replace from the short text you type ("person" works for most clips; be more specific in a crowded scene). The prompt describes the final video: the character's looks, what they do and the setting.

Turn "Replace mode" off to animate your character instead — they perform the video's motion in a scene you describe in the prompt. "Fast mode" (on by default) uses a 6-step distilled LoRA; turning it off runs the full 40-step path, which is many times slower.

The video is generated in two overlapping 81-frame chunks, so only about the first 157 frames (≈6.5 s at 24 fps) are used. It is center-cropped to width × height (896×512 landscape by default — swap the numbers for a portrait clip). Works best with one clearly visible person, framed like the character image.
author: Template - ComfyUI

exposedParameters.default: A young East Asian woman with dark hair neatly pulled back, wearing a white sleeveless ribbed mock-neck top, is standing in a lush apple orchard. She holds a large glossy red apple with both hands, using a white paper handkerchief to wipe and clean the apple before smelling and eating it with her eyes closed and a blissful expression. Ripe red and yellow apples hang from leafy branches in the foreground, with rows of green apple trees softly blurred in the background under natural daylight.
